description: Runs JavaScript inside the paused checkpoint of a live session started with live_test_start. The code runs in the test's scope with access to fixtures such as page, and may use multiple statements and await. Returns stdout, stderr, exitCode, a fresh inline ARIA snapshot, and paths to artifacts such as screenshots. A non-zero exitCode means the code threw; the session remains paused and this tool can be called repeatedly.

code.description: JavaScript to execute inside the paused test scope. The code may use `await` and access test fixtures such as `page`.

name: live_test_run
